notes.title: Official AirBuccaneers Guide Out Now!
notes.content: GamerGuides has released their Official AirBuccaneers Strategy Guide! Watch the trailer: [url=http://youtu.be/Jo_jyuOnCNU]http://youtu.be/Jo_jyuOnCNU[/url] Grab the guide: [url=http://www.gamerguides.com/airbuccaneers/][/url] [url=http://www.gamerguides.com/airbuccaneers/]http://www.gamerguides.com/airbuccaneers/[/url] Here's some of the stuff you can expect to find in the guide: * Break down all four classes with Beginner, Intermediate and Advanced tactics, written in easy to understand English and accompanied by stunning 1080p HD video and screenshots * What every Perk and Flaw is, what Class XP you need and the best ones to select for your class * Tell you how the XP systems work and every way you can earn the XP you want * Reveal all 60 ranks and the Personal XP needed to reach all of them * Teach you how to fly – and how to destroy – every type of ship like a pro * Exclusive data on ship HP, attack HP, Perk/Flaw stacking and more! * Packed with exclusive info and data straight from the developers at Ludocraft!

notes.title: Official AirBuccaneers Guide Out Now!
notes.content:
GamerGuides has released their Official AirBuccaneers Strategy Guide!

Watch the trailer:
[url=http://youtu.be/Jo_jyuOnCNU]http://youtu.be/Jo_jyuOnCNU[/url]

Grab the guide:
[url=http://www.gamerguides.com/airbuccaneers/][img]http://ludocraft.com/airbuccaneers/airbuccaneers_gamerguides_cover_300px.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=http://www.gamerguides.com/airbuccaneers/]http://www.gamerguides.com/airbuccaneers/[/url]

Here's some of the stuff you can expect to find in the guide:
  * Break down all four classes with Beginner, Intermediate and Advanced tactics, written in easy to understand English and accompanied by stunning 1080p HD video and screenshots
  * What every Perk and Flaw is, what Class XP you need and the best ones to select for your class
  * Tell you how the XP systems work and every way you can earn the XP you want
  * Reveal all 60 ranks and the Personal XP needed to reach all of them
  * Teach you how to fly – and how to destroy – every type of ship like a pro
  * Exclusive data on ship HP, attack HP, Perk/Flaw stacking and more!
  * Packed with exclusive info and data straight from the developers at Ludocraft!
